title: مشكلة
body:
أواجه مشكلة عند تسجيل الدخول إلى الحساب من جهازين مختلفين، حيث يتم تسجيل الخروج تلقائياً من الجهاز الأول بمجرد تسجيل الدخول من الجهاز الثاني، مما يمنع استخدام الحساب على أكثر من جهاز في الوقت نفسه.

علماً بأن القسم التقني سبق أن تواصل معي وأفادني بأنه سيتم حل هذه المشكلة في التحديثات القادمة، ولكن حتى الآن لم يتم حلها وما زالت المشكلة قائمة.

لذا، أقترح إتاحة استخدام التطبيق على ما لا يقل عن 5 أجهزة في الوقت نفسه، أسوةً بالتطبيقات المصرفية الأخرى، لما في ذلك من تسهيل على المستخدمين وتوفير مرونة أكبر في الوصول إلى حساباتهم.

نأمل منكم النظر في هذه الملاحظة والعمل على معالجة المشكلة في أقرب تحديث ممكن.

title: Request to add custom daily & monthly limit
body:
Dear ADIB Team,

I hope you are doing well.

I would like to request the addition of a feature in the ADIB banking app that allows customers to set custom daily and monthly spending limits for their debit cards.
This feature would greatly improve security, budgeting, and overall user convenience by giving customers better control over their card usage.

I kindly ask you to consider adding:

* Custom daily transaction limits
* Custom monthly spending limits
* Easy limit management through the mobile app

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to seeing this feature in future updates.

Best regards
Ishtiaq Ahmad

title: Good but with serious issues
body:

I had to move my accounts and credit cards to another bank because of this

Login into ADIB app
Select more options

Toggle the Notifications switch OFF and switch ON the SMS service.

title: New App Update
body:
The recent updates to the ADIB mobile banking app have made simple transfers unnecessarily complicated. Previously, transferring funds took less than a minute, but now the process requires entering a transfer purpose and waiting for an OTP every time, which significantly slows things down.

I hope ADIB considers simplifying the transfer process again to balance both security and ease of use.

title: Lagging
body: The app occasionally lag then it redirects me to contact their WhatsApp which has no option to report app malfunction and when I ask to chat with an agent it takes several hours to reach to one. You’d think a bank can afford a better functioning app, apparently, in their case, sounds like they don’t prefer to spend funds on improvements. The bank also has no discount offers/vouchers for online purchases. While I appreciate the speed of other functions (when it’s not down) they can’t compensate for the frustration of trying to open the app and find an “Error” message that lasts for days. Finally, the benefit rates are inflated, you would not expect this from an Islamic bank following sharia law which prohibits Reba (loan benefit exchange) I’m seriously contemplating switching to another bank once I pay all my dues. They didn’t even allow me to switch and pay through another bank.

title: Outdated device management which is stuck in 2010
body:
ADIB’s mobile app desperately needs a device management feature. Every other bank whether local or international allows you to log in on a new phone simply by completing a proper authentication step (OTP, biometric verification, etc.). With ADIB, changing your phone means you’re forced to call the call center just to unlink your old device.

And to make matters worse, the call center charges you per minute for the call. So not only is the process needlessly inconvenient, it’s also costing customers money for a problem that should be self-serviceable within the app itself.
This is basic functionality in 2026. 

A dedicated “Manage Devices” section in the app where users can view and remove linked devices securely is table stakes for any modern banking app. Please prioritize this fix. It’s frustrating, time-consuming and frankly, embarrassing for a bank of ADIB’s size.

body:
The document renewal feature in the ADIB Bank app needs urgent improvement.

Please fix the document scanning and renewal issue as soon as possible.
